annotations.title: Send a message to Ménage Parfait

description: Sends a written message to the Ménage Parfait team on behalf of the customer: a question, a special request, or a change or cancellation of an existing booking. The team replies by email to the customer. Returns a reference (MP-MSG-...). Plain text only, max 2000 characters and 3 links. Never include card or bank details.

agent_name.description: Name of the assistant/app sending the message

booking_ref.description: Booking reference, if the message is about an existing booking

message.description: The customer's message, in their words

phone.description: Optional, with country code if not French

name: send_message
title: Send a message to Ménage Parfait
